title: The Multilingual Alignment Prism: Aligning Global and Local Preferences to Reduce Harm
findings: The paper's findings are general to mitigating 'local' and 'global' harms across languages. While religion is included as a category of harm (Discrimination & Injustice), the paper does not present specific quantitative findings solely for religion. The results show that the tested alignment methods are effective in reducing overall harmful generations, which would include religiously discriminatory content.
